==Description==
The '''Marionette''' was the seventh enemy that appeared in [[The Great Finale]] of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a rather low amount of health, lower than almost all enemies that appeared before it, though it was faster than all of them.

==Appearance==
The '''Marionette''' was a puppet made out of wood. It had lower arms and legs in its rig. It had a carved head, resembling a mannequin. It was connected to a wooden crossbeam by a few strings.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Accelerator]] are sufficient to deal with the '''Marionette'''.
**Multiple weaker towers, like the [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Golden Soldier]] can also do quite well.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be quite useful at boosting the firerate and range of your towers.
*The '''Marionette''' usually spawns in hordes. Because of this, towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Executioner]] can be quite effective.
